info.title: Load Test Run Manager API
info.description: Upload test bundles, queue runs, follow live statistics and fetch reports. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Scopes are hierarchical: admin > run > read.

get.summary: Identity and scope of the caller
Active run, queue length and server limits

post.summary: Store a plan with its assets. Load and duration limits are enforced when a run is created, with its overrides

422.description: Invalid bundle, plan or policy violation

delete.summary: Delete a bundle not used by a queued or running run

post.summary: Queue a run of a stored bundle

200.description: Replay of an earlier request with the same Idempotency-Key

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeating a request with the same key returns the original run.

delete.summary: Delete a finished run and its artifacts

post.summary: Cancel a queued run or stop the running one gracefully

get.summary: Live statistics of a running run, or the final statistics
Server-sent events: `run` (Run) on state changes, `stats` (Snapshot) every second, `end` (Run) when finished
Download a report of a finished run

post.summary: Validate a plan (with optional run overrides) without storing it; lists the files a bundle must carry

get.summary: Compare a finished run with a baseline run

bearer.description: API token issued by the server operator

files.description: Binary or extra assets referenced by the plan (relative path to base64 content). Inline scripts and feeder rows need no files.

id.description: Content hash; uploading identical content returns the same id

users.description: Peak users (or iterations/s in arrival-rate mode); replaces the load profile with a ramp

host.description: Base URL; must be allowed by the plan and the server

workers.description: Pool workers to use: 0 runs on the server only; unset uses every available worker

Target.description: System under test, as reached from the load generator host

shape_source.description: Inline shape script; stored in the bundle

Step.description: Exactly one of: a request, think, feed, set, txn_begin, txn_end or batch

get.description: GET request path or absolute URL; supports ${var} templates

post.description: POST request path or absolute URL; supports ${var} templates

put.description: PUT request path or absolute URL; supports ${var} templates

patch.description: PATCH request path or absolute URL; supports ${var} templates

delete.description: DELETE request path or absolute URL; supports ${var} templates

head.description: HEAD request path or absolute URL; supports ${var} templates

additionalProperties.description: json.<path>, header.<name>, status, body or between:<left>|<right>

feed.description: Reads the next feeder row into the variable of the same name

source.description: Inline script source; stored in the bundle

script.description: Script file path inside the bundle

rows.description: Inline data: objects, or arrays matching columns

PlanDocument.description: Structured plan. Null values are rejected; omit optional fields instead.

protocols.description: grpc, mqtt, kafka and sql connection settings

files.description: Files the bundle must still carry

RegressionGate.description: Fail the run when it is worse than a baseline run beyond these limits

baseline.description: 'auto' (latest passed run of the same plan) or a run id
